knowledge:
- key_parameters: binSize=Resolution (in base pairs) used for binning, snapping, or pulling data from .hic files ;; radius=Genomic distance threshold (in base pairs) used by mergePairs() to cluster nearby interactions ;; column=Metadata column name used in mergePairs() to select the representative interaction ;; selectMax=Logical indicating whether to select the interaction with the maximum value in the specified column ;; buffer=Buffer size in pixels around a central pixel used to define submatrices or selection regions ;; fg=Foreground selection matrix/function used in calcLoopEnrichment() ;; bg=Background selection matrix/function used in calcLoopEnrichment()
- alternatives: InteractionSet=mariner extends the GInteractions class and accessors from this package ;; strawr=Used to inspect metadata (normalizations, resolutions, chromosomes) of .hic files ;; plotgardener=A genomic visualization package compatible with plotMatrix() for advanced figure layout
- when_to_use: Use when you have chromatin loop calls (e.g., BEDPE format) from multiple replicates and want to generate a consensus set, extract contact frequencies or submatrices from .hic files, aggregate contact matrices for aggregate peak analysis (APA), or calculate loop enrichment over local backgrounds.
- pitfalls: Coordinate systems differ because GenomicRanges/GInteractions are 1-based while .hic files are 0-based; assignToBins() handles this by returning ranges of width binSize + 1 ;; Chromosome naming styles must match between the GInteractions object and the .hic files (e.g., 'ENSEMBL' vs 'UCSC'), which can be resolved using GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle() ;; Large datasets can cause memory issues; use the block processing parameters (e.g., blockSize in pulling functions or nBlocks in aggHicMatrices()) to manage memory usage.

workflows.name: loop_merging_and_replicate_comparison
workflows.intent: Merge chromatin loops from multiple replicates, resolve duplicates within a specified radius, and identify shared or unique loops.
input: FS_5kbLoops.txt (BEDPE file of loops for replicate FS)
WT_5kbLoops.txt (BEDPE file of loops for replicate WT)
workflows.stages: 1. Read BEDPE files into R ;; 2. Convert to GInteractions objects ;; 3. Merge nearby interactions across replicates using mergePairs() ;; 4. Inspect clustered interactions and identify unique/shared sets using sets() and sources()
workflows.code:
library(mariner)
library(marinerData)

## BEDPE-formatted files
bedpeFiles <- c(
    marinerData::FS_5kbLoops.txt(),
    marinerData::WT_5kbLoops.txt()
)
names(bedpeFiles) <- c("FS", "WT")

## Read as list of GInteractions
giList <-
    lapply(bedpeFiles, read.table, header=TRUE) |>
    lapply(as_ginteractions)

lapply(giList, summary)
mgi <- mergePairs(
    x=giList,
    radius=10e3,
    column="APScoreAvg",
    selectMax=TRUE
)
mgi
mgi[12772]
clusters(mgi[12772])
## List the input sources
sources(mgi)

## Interactions unique to each source
sets(mgi) |> lapply(summary)

## Interactions shared by both sources
sets(x=mgi, include=sources(mgi))

workflows.name: extract_and_aggregate_hic_matrices
workflows.intent: Extract submatrices around chromatin loops from .hic files, aggregate them across interactions or files, and plot the aggregated matrix.
workflows.stages: 1. Read and merge loops ;; 2. Match chromosome naming styles to the .hic files ;; 3. Assign loops to bins ;; 4. Define submatrix regions with a buffer using pixelsToMatrices() ;; 5. Pull contact matrices using pullHicMatrices() ;; 6. Aggregate matrices using aggHicMatrices() ;; 7. Plot the aggregated matrix using plotMatrix()
workflows.code:
library(mariner)
library(marinerData)

## BEDPE-formatted files
bedpeFiles <- c(
    marinerData::FS_5kbLoops.txt(),
    marinerData::WT_5kbLoops.txt()
)
names(bedpeFiles) <- c("FS", "WT")

## Read as list of GInteractions
giList <-
    lapply(bedpeFiles, read.table, header=TRUE) |>
    lapply(as_ginteractions)

## Merge
mgi <- mergePairs(x=giList, radius=10e3, column="APScoreAvg")

summary(mgi)
library(marinerData)
hicFiles <- c(
    LEUK_HEK_PJA27_inter_30.hic(),
    LEUK_HEK_PJA30_inter_30.hic()
)
names(hicFiles) <- c("FS", "WT")
hicFiles
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(mgi) <- 'ENSEMBL'
## Assign interactions to 100Kb bins
binned <- assignToBins(x=mgi, binSize=100e3)
## Define region with 1-pixel buffer
regions <- pixelsToMatrices(x=binned[1:1000], buffer=1)

## Pull 3x3 matrices from 1000 interactions and 2 hic files
iarr <- pullHicMatrices(
    x=regions,
    files=hicFiles,
    binSize=100e3
)

## See count matrices
counts(iarr)
mat <- aggHicMatrices(x=iarr)
plotMatrix(data=mat)

workflows.name: calculate_loop_enrichment
workflows.intent: Calculate the enrichment of chromatin loops compared to their local background.
workflows.stages: 1. Read loops and assign to bins ;; 2. Match chromosome naming styles to the .hic files ;; 3. Define foreground and background selection regions using selection functions ;; 4. Calculate loop enrichment using calcLoopEnrichment()
workflows.code:
library(mariner)
library(marinerData)

## Define hicFiles
hicFiles <- c(
    LEUK_HEK_PJA27_inter_30.hic(),
    LEUK_HEK_PJA30_inter_30.hic()
) |> setNames(c("FS", "WT"))

## Read in loops
loops <- 
    WT_5kbLoops.txt() |>
    setNames("WT") |>
    read.table(header=TRUE, nrows=1000) |>
    as_ginteractions() |>
    assignToBins(binSize=100e3) |>
    GenomeInfoDb::`seqlevelsStyle<-`('ENSEMBL')

## Define foreground & background
buffer <- 10
fg <- selectCenterPixel(mhDist=0:1, buffer=buffer)
bg <- selectTopLeft(n=2, buffer=buffer) +
    selectBottomRight(n=2, buffer=buffer)

## Calculate loop enrichment
enrich <- calcLoopEnrichment(
    x=loops,
    files=hicFiles,
    fg=fg,
    bg=bg
)
enrich
